Bill.BriefDescription: Specifying penalties for aircraft registration violations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to aircraft registration violation penalties;amending RCW 47.68.240; prescribing penalties; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.68.240 and 2000 c 229 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person violating any of the provisions of this chapter, orany of the rules, regulations, or orders issued pursuant thereto, shallbe guilty of a misdemeanor and shall be punished as provided underchapter 9A.20 RCW, except that any person violating any of theprovisions of RCW 47.68.220, 47.68.230, or 47.68.255 shall be guilty ofa gross misdemeanor which shall be punished as provided under chapter9A.20 RCW. A person in violation of RCW 47.68.230 is also subject toa penalty of four times the fees that are due. In addition to, or inlieu of, the penalties provided in this section, or as a condition tothe suspension of a sentence which may be imposed pursuant thereto, forviolations of RCW 47.68.220 and 47.68.230, the court in its discretionmay prohibit the violator from operating an aircraft within the state p. 1 SB 5961for such period as it may determine but not to exceed one year.Violation of the duly imposed prohibition of the court may be treatedas a separate offense under this section or as a contempt of court. (2) In lieu of the penalties in subsection (1) of this section, aviolation of RCW 47.68.250 is a misdemeanor punishable and is subjectto a penalty of one hundred dollars per aircraft for the firstviolation. Subsequent violations in the same year are subject to thefollowing fines: (a) For the second violation, a fine of two hundred dollars peraircraft; (b) For the third and subsequent violations, a fine of four hundreddollars per aircraft. (3) The revenue from penalties prescribed in subsection (2) of thissection and for a violation of RCW 47.68.230 must be deposited into theaeronautics account under RCW 82.42.090.
